1.description: Variant - Quick Starter : After the initial setup, each player in turn order moves down 2 of their Progress markers into the 2nd row of their Development board OR takes 10 ducats from the bank.

1.name: Enabled
1.description: Variant - Bonanza : at the beginning of each phase (Day and Night), shuffle the 8 Bonanza tiles and put 1, face down, under each of the 4 tiles located in the corners. When a player buys the tile above, they also immediately receive the bonus of the Bonanza tile.

1.name: Random Story
1.description: Variant - Stories : The stories introduce new twists to the rules, some beneficial and others challenging. Adapt your strategy to leverage each storyline, turning obstacles into opportunities for greater rewards.

1.name: Enabled
1.description: Variant - Captains : Setup: give 2 captains to each player to choose 1. Gameplay: some captains give an ability during the game, others a boost in the setup.

1.name: Enabled
1.description: Variant - Gambit : Each player receives 8 cards in their colour. After placing the bidding tiles on the board, each player secretly chooses one of their Impact cards and plays it face down. When a player starts their bidding round, they reveal their card. The modified action then applies and is visible to all players.

1.description: Campaign module : Play 3 successive sessions and try to become the richest merchant.
